verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਸਮਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੇ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat mil saadhasa(n)g gurmukh dhukh sukh samakar saadhe|

en.bdb: In the holy congregation, getting attuned to the Word, the gurmukh treats pains and joys in the same vein.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਰਹਰੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ।
verses.translit_en: haumai dhuramat paraharee gurmat satigur purakh aaraadhe|

en.bdb: He renounces egotist ill thoughts and adopting the teachings of the true Guru adores the Timeless Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਨੋ ਲੰਘਿਕੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧੇ।
verses.translit_en: siv sakatee no la(n)ghikai gurmukh sukh fal sahaj samaadhe|

en.bdb: Going beyond the phenomena of the Siva-Sakti (maya), the Gurnzukh calmly merges in the fruits of delight.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਏਕ ਜਾਣਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਉਪਾਧੇ।
verses.translit_en: gur paramesar ek jaan dhoojaa bhaau miTai upaadhe|

en.bdb: Considering Guru and God as one, he decimates the ills of the sense of duality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣਹੁ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਅਜਰਾਵਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧੇ।
verses.translit_en: ja(n)man maranahu baahare ajaraavar mil agam agaadhe|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs go out of the cycle of transmigration and meeting that unapproachable and unfathomable Lord go away from the impacts of time (oldage).

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ਘਰਿ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਵਿਹੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਖਾਧੇ।
verses.translit_en: aas na traas udhaas ghar harakh sog vih a(n)mirat khaadhe|

en.bdb: Hopes and fears do not torture them. They reside in home while being detached and to them nectar or poison, happiness and sorrows are all the same.
In the holy congregation, the frightening chronic ailments are also cured.
